notToBeConfusedWith.name: Coconut milk
notToBeConfusedWith.note: The clear liquid found inside a young coconut, not the white liquid pressed from grated flesh.

forms.label: Raw, from the fruit
forms.sourceNote: Nuts, coconut water (liquid from coconuts). Public domain. The record's own cup portion gives 1.0144 g/ml, adopted because coconut water is poured, but marked estimated since a cup can measure either a liquid or a packed solid and this one is not confirmed against a liquid measure.
